clinicalClaimInvalidationAudit.invalidatedClaim: FaceScan V6 claim of Independent Dual-Physician Validation (Rater A Plastic Surgeon vs. Rater B Aesthetic Dermatologist, Pearson r = 0.9991, Inter-rater QWK = 0.9047, LOSO-CV QWK = 0.7335–0.7488)

forensicProof.conclusion: rater_b was programmatically or manually offset by +0.2 from rater_a and is NOT an independent physician assessment. All claims of dual-physician validation based on PHYSICIAN_REFERENCE_DATASET_15 are formally invalidated.

frozenCheckpoints.system: System A — FaceScan V6 10-Region Crease-Valley Calibrator
frozenCheckpoints.trainingDataset: 17 portrait images in scratch/intrarat_face_sagging_detection/dataset/ (10 regions/image = 170 feature vectors)
frozenCheckpoints.labelProvenance: INVALIDATED_DUAL_PHYSICIAN_CLAIM: Calibrated against hardcoded developer table PHYSICIAN_REFERENCE_DATASET_15 where rater_b = rater_a + 0.2 (92.9% of entries). Retained strictly as a heuristic sub-region contour severity calibrator.

preprocessingSpec.canonicalCrop: 240x280 landmark-aligned face crop with Z-score luminance (mean=135, std=36) + local illumination envelope (sigma=16.0)
preprocessingSpec.featureVector16: 10 multi-scale Gaussian/Sobel/anisotropic Hessian valley trough features standardized by feature_mean_10 / feature_std_10 + 6-dim region group one-hot
preprocessingSpec.contourSuppressionGate: Regions with predicted severity < 0.75/4.0 emit detected=False and 0 polygon overlays
